name: HPC Fracing Operations
description: Submits hydraulic fracturing treatment plans to the HPC/CFD simulation pipeline (issue #504) and returns tiered screen-out-risk recommendations with mandatory financial justification. Blocked on a live end-to-end run until the `enableHpc` CDK context flag is on and the CFD McpServer is seeded (see PR notes).

agent.name: HPC Fracing Operations
agent.description: Reviews fracture treatment plans and real-time pressure data, submits/polls CFD simulations, and recommends Tier 1-4 actions with quantified financial impact.

mcpServers.name: CFD Simulation Tools
mcpServers.description: AgentCore Gateway target exposing SubmitCfdSimulation/GetCfdJobStatus/GetCfdResults (issue #504). Only seeded when the backend is deployed with the `enableHpc` CDK context flag on — see web/amplify/backend.ts:1262. Placeholder URL matches this sandbox's gateway; refresh from web/amplify_outputs.json (`custom.agentcore_gateway_endpoint`) after (re)deploy.

mcpServers.name: S3 Filesystem Tools
mcpServers.description: AgentCore Gateway exposing the ApplyDiff/ListFiles/ReadFile/DeleteFile/UploadFile S3 filesystem tools (issue #240) — used for reading treatment-plan inputs and rendering CFD/plot artifacts under /artifacts.

mcpServers.name: Athena PySpark Tools
mcpServers.description: AgentCore Gateway target exposing SubmitPySpark/GetPySparkStatus/GetPySparkResults (issue #501) — optional, used for ad-hoc pressure-curve/ensemble analysis and plotting alongside the CFD tools.
